```{r}
# ---------- Question 2 ----------
fib <- function(n) {
  if (n == 0) return(0)
  prev <- 0
  curr <- 1
  if (n >= 2) {
    for (i in 2:n) {
      nxt  <- prev + curr
      prev <- curr
      curr <- nxt
    }
  }
  curr
}

fib(3)
format(fib(50), scientific = FALSE, big.mark = ",")
```
```{r}

# ---------- Question 3 ----------
nums <- 1:100
result <- nums[nums %% 3 == 0 & nums %% 5 == 0]
for (v in result) {
  print(v)
}

```

```{r}
# ---------- Question 4 ----------
div_3_5 <- function(n) {
  v <- 1:n
  v[v %% 3 == 0 & v %% 5 == 0]
}
div_3_5(100)
div_3_5(200)
```

```{r}
# ---------- Question 5 ----------
smallest_common_multiple <- function(a, b) {
  candidate <- max(a, b)
  while (candidate %% a != 0 || candidate %% b != 0) {
    candidate <- candidate + 1
  }
  candidate
}

smallest_common_multiple(3, 5)
smallest_common_multiple(6, 10)
```
